refusalAnalysis.classification: Intentional fail-closed behavior, also a migration compatibility limitation. Not introduced by Ocean: the pinned upstream v2-to-v3 migration has the same refusal.
refusalAnalysis.cause: A surface message precedes the first step/system head. Inserting a head would change chronology, so the migration deliberately refuses instead of fabricating history.
refusalAnalysis.userImpact: Affected old histories cannot currently be opened through the current format chain. Retain the original data and a compatible old application or explicit export; do not repair or rewrite in place.
